description:
“Go to the arranged date with Kwon Do-yoon.”

In a world where national matching programs can reveal your compatibility rate with another person, Seung-ho is forced to go to an arranged date with Kwon Do-yoon due to the sudden flight of his half-sister, Seung-hee...the only family member who truly cared for him. In order to secure freedom for his Noona, who left to find a fateful love rather than one bound by numbers, Seung-ho must successfully pull off a marriage with Kwon Do-yoon, a man notoriously rumored to be a total libertine. Summoning all his courage from day one, Seung-ho succeeds in heading into a hotel with Do-yoon. However…

“Have you ever masturbated?” 
“Of course I've tried…”  
“No, not standard masturbation… I mean nipple masturbation.”

Kwon Do-yoon, rumored to be a libertine, turned out to be far more promiscuous and lewd than imaginable! Will Seung-ho be able to succeed in this matching fraud scheme using his Noona's freedom as collateral?
